name: lean-jira-mcp
description: Lean, agent-first MCP server for JIRA Cloud: ~10 intent-shaped tools with markdown I/O and recovery hints.
long_description: A small, opinionated MCP server for JIRA Cloud. It exposes a handful of intent-shaped tools (search, read/create/update issues, transition, comment, describe project, read and attach files) instead of a 1:1 REST mapping, flattens rich text to markdown on read and accepts markdown on write, resolves human-friendly references (emails, "me", status names) server-side, and stamps every response with recovery hints. Authentication is a JIRA Cloud email + API token supplied via host-managed environment — never via tool arguments.

base_url.title: JIRA base URL
base_url.description: Your JIRA Cloud site, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net

email.title: Atlassian account email
email.description: The email of the account whose API token you use (HTTP basic auth).

api_token.title: API token (classic, unscoped)
api_token.description: Create at id.atlassian.com with "Create API token" — NOT "with scopes". A scoped token fails basic auth and silently returns empty results.

project_default.title: Default project key
project_default.description: Project key used when jira_create_issue is called without an explicit project (e.g. PROJ).

comment_marker.title: Agent comment marker
comment_marker.description: Visible marker prefixed to every comment the agent posts, so humans can spot them in the JIRA UI.

field_story_points.title: Story Points field id (advanced)
field_story_points.description: Custom-field id backing Story Points. Auto-detected per instance at startup — set this only if detection misses (the server logs a warning naming any omitted field).

field_sprint.title: Sprint field id (advanced)
field_sprint.description: Custom-field id backing Sprint. Auto-detected per instance at startup — set this only if detection misses (the server logs a warning naming any omitted field).

field_epic_link.title: Epic Link field id (advanced)
field_epic_link.description: Custom-field id backing Epic Link. Auto-detected per instance at startup — set this only if detection misses (the server logs a warning naming any omitted field).

attachment_max_bytes.title: Attachment read ceiling in bytes (advanced)
attachment_max_bytes.description: Hard byte ceiling for jira_read_attachment — a file larger than this is refused before download (a note + download URL is returned instead). Defaults to 25 MB.

attachment_root.title: Attachment upload roots (advanced)
attachment_root.description: Path-delimiter-separated list of directories jira_add_attachment may upload FROM. A path resolving outside all roots (after symlink/.. resolution) is refused, blocking exfiltration of files like ~/.ssh. Defaults cover only agent-produced dirs (project dir + OS temp dirs); a dir holding personal files (e.g. ~/Downloads) is a deliberate opt-in.

attachment_upload_max_bytes.title: Attachment upload size cap in bytes (advanced)
attachment_upload_max_bytes.description: Size cap for jira_add_attachment — a larger file is refused with a hint instead of a raw 413. Defaults to 25 MB. JIRA's own per-instance limit may be lower.

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Search issues with raw JQL; returns compact cards with opaque-cursor pagination.

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Read one issue at summary or full detail, with curated agile fields and optional comments.

tools.name: jira_create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue from a summary (project/type defaulted); returns key and URL.

tools.name: jira_update_issue
tools.description: Partial issue update with add/remove/replace deltas for multi-value fields.

tools.name: jira_transition
tools.description: Transition an issue by transition name or target status, with proactive screen-field validation.

tools.name: jira_comment
tools.description: Post or edit a comment as markdown; auto-stamps agent authorship.

tools.name: jira_get_comments
tools.description: Read a comment thread (full bodies) with authoredBy resolution and since-last-agent-comment delta.

tools.name: jira_describe_project
tools.description: Discover a project's issue types, statuses, and named transition graph.

tools.name: jira_read_attachment
tools.description: Read one attachment by id: images come back downscaled as image blocks, text token-budgeted, PDFs as server-extracted text (page-budgeted via pageRange), other types as metadata + download note.

tools.name: jira_add_attachment
tools.description: Attach one local file to an issue by path (the file must exist on disk). Paths are scoped to safe roots, MIME is detected from content, same-name dupes are refused unless allowDuplicate is set.
